name: Headset
description: A design left behind by an old craftsman, later found and roughly reproduced by his grandson. Similar to slightly stiff Ear Muffs.

name: Jewel Crown
description: A rounded cloth crown adorned with a jewel on top, radiating a classic sense of dignity.
Equippable by : [color=777777]Swordsman Class, Merchant Class, Thief Class[/color]
jobs: Swordsman Class, Merchant Class, Thief Class

name: Joker Jester
description: A colorful, jagged hat reminiscent of what a jester might wear.

name: Oxygen Mask
description: A device equipped with a front filter that removes harmful air, allowing fresh air to be breathed anywhere. Despite sharing the name with the underwater version, it functions completely different.

name: Gas Mask
description: A mask equipped with a filter that removes harmful air, allowing you to breathe fresh air at all times—though it can feel a bit stifling.

name: Grand Circlet
description: A Circlet said to be worn by leaders of a certain tribe. The central red gem is rumored to symbolize great authority.

name: Safety Helmet
description: A helmet worn to prevent worksite accidents. Its rounded design greatly reduces impact and its sturdiness protects the wearer from most hazards.

name: Indian Fillet
description: A Headband that looks like something worn by natives living deep in jungles or remote wilderness.

name: Aerial
description: A set of long metal rods aligned and fixed together. Found deep underwater, though its purpose remains unknown.

name: Ph.D Hat
description: A hat worn during school graduation ceremonies. Surprisingly firm, and getting struck by its sharp corners is said to bring pain reminiscent of hell.

name: Egg Shell
description: Sturdy Decorative Eggshell worn on the head. Its glossy shell is tougher than it looks, and rumors say it can momentarily make others mistake you for someone with certain traits.

name: Bone Helm
description: Helmet crafted from bone, extremely solid but heavy. Difficult for most to wear, yet its defensive power is remarkable.

name: Feather Bonnet
description: A Hat that is stylishly adorned with a single old-fashioned feather.

name: Corsair
description: A large hat worn by a pirate captain. Made oversized to project the captain’s authority, it almost resembles a pirate ship drifting across the sea—though it is quite worn out.

name: Cake Hat
description: A celebratory hat often worn on birthdays. While it may draw congratulations, it may also earn cold stares. Since it's only a model, be careful not to bite it—your teeth will regret it.

name: Chef Hat
description: Hat commonly seen in restaurants, with height believed (though unproven) to reflect rank and skill.

name: Candle
description: With melted, sticky Candle wax atop its surface, this item gives off a strangely alluring atmosphere to certain individuals.

name: Panda Hat
description: Adorable panda-like hat that makes you imagine yourself snacking on bamboo leaves the moment you wear it. Surprisingly popular among women.

name: Mine Hat
description: Safety Helmet equipped with a headlight to illuminate dark places. Boasts a sturdiness capable of withstanding blows from even the toughest heads.
Equippable by : [color=777777]Swordsman Class, Thief Class, Acolyte Class, Merchant Class[/color]
jobs: Swordsman Class, Thief Class, Acolyte Class, Merchant Class

name: Raccoon Hat
description: Hat made for those who wish to resemble a raccoon. Its creator is unknown, but it seems remarkably popular among men.

name: Bulb Band
description: Headband that looks as if it will make your head shine when worn. Rest assured, it does not mean you are bald.

name: Poring Hat
description: Hat modeled after the wildly popular monster Poring. Definitely not made from rubber gloves, no matter how it looks!

name: Cross Hat
description: Headband decorated with a cross-shaped accessory on top, light and cute.

name: Nut Shell
description: Hat made from the hard shell of a fruit cut in half. Sturdy and offers excellent defense, but cannot be refined because it breaks when hammered.

name: Rainbow Eggshell
description: Eggshell made from a colorful, unknown egg. Surprisingly large, even those with big heads can wear it with confidence. Cannot be refined since it will break if hammered.

name: Heart Hairpin
description: Cute hairpin decorated with heart-shaped symbols of love, arranged in a charming pattern. Makes the wearer look extra adorable.

name: Opera Phantom Mask
description: Mask said to have been worn by a tragic protagonist from some tale. Staring at it for too long makes their sorrow feel as if it seeps into your own body.

name: Magician Hat
description: Magician Hat that looks like a rabbit might jump out the moment you reach inside. Fairly sturdy and not easily broken.

name: Bongun Hat
description: Hat once worn by Bongun, featuring a half-torn talisman on the front. Surprisingly sturdy, and the torn charm even helps keep it out of the wearer’s line of sight.

name: Fashionable Glasses
description: Sunglasses with a surprisingly comfortable fit and attention-grabbing effect beyond expectations. Their refined style helps the wearer look effortlessly cool.

name: Striped Hairband
description: Headband with bold, flowing stripes that stand out.

name: Blue Hairband
description: Headband in a slanted blue design that catches the eye with its stylish shape.

name: Sphinx Hat
description: Hat that looks like it could be seen in a distant land and symbolizes the sun. Tougher than it appears.

name: Flower Hairpin
description: Hairpin shaped like a red flower in full bloom, used to hold back loose strands of hair.

name: Straw Hat
description: Cool summer straw hat that makes you want to cut grass and enjoy the feeling of harvest.

name: Giant Band Aid
description: White Bandage strips crossed into a simple X shape. Perfect for acting as if you are injured.

name: Smokie Leaf
description: Leaf said to be placed on the head when Smokie transforms. It seems this transformative power is exclusive to Smokie.

name: Blue Fish
description: A helmet shaped like a plump, appetizing blue fish. The fishy smell is probably just your imagination.
Increases damage to Fish Monsters by 10%.

name: Sombrero
description: Part of traditional attire from a hot region, this hat features a wide, tapered conical brim.

name: Kitsune Mask
description: Mask modeled after those worn by a certain assassin squad to conceal their identity. Wearing it somehow makes you feel nimbler.

name: Hot-blooded Headband
description: Burning resolve and determination are embodied in this Headband. Wearing it makes you want to clench your fists without realizing it.

name: Model Training Hat
description: Training method for learning a calm and proper walking posture: balance an apple and a book on your head and walk without dropping either.
Good practice for those who lack caution.

name: Beanie
description: Fur Hat designed with the sole purpose of keeping head warm. Some people seem to wear it more for style than insulation.

name: Tulip Hairpin
description: Hairpin in the adorable shape of a scarlet tulip flower.

name: Decorative Mushroom
description: Headband made using mushrooms said to randomly sprout on heads left too long in damp, shady places. Naturally, they are not edible.

name: Small Ribbons
description: Small pair of red ribbons that serves as a charming accent, making young girls look even cuter.

name: Poker Face
description: Mask with eyes and mouth shaped the same, giving a perfectly blank, detached expression. Suits those moments when you are forced to listen to a painfully unfunny joke.

name: Surprised Mask
description: Mask with a wide-eyed, round expression. Try wearing it when something truly surprising happens.

name: Annoyed Mask
description: Mask perfect for when something is so annoying or unfunny that it just makes you sick of it. That is pretty much its only purpose.

name: Goblin Leader Mask
description: Mask that conveys the firm resolve befitting Goblin leaders. Still, in the end, it is just Goblin.

name: Coif
description: Hat worn by cathedral nuns, symbolizing modesty and self-restraint by keeping the hair concealed.

name: Angry Snarl
description: Item shaped after Angry Mouth, enabling various expressions like an angry cat or an angry rabbit.

name: Banana Hat
description: A fruit peel known for being slippery when stepped on. Wearing this in battle seems to irritate opponents.
Triggers Auto-Spell Provoke Lv 3 with a certain chance when performing physical attacks.

name: Zealotus Mask
description: A mask symbolizing Zealotus, the mistress of the Glast Heim Underground Prison. Wearing it gives the unsettling feeling of looking down on humans.

name: Angel's Kiss
description: A headpiece blessed by the guardian angel of Super Novice. Kissing this ornament might feel like receiving an indirect kiss from an angel.

name: Marionette Doll
description: A doll modeled after the popular monster Marionette. Wearing it gives a slight chill on top of the head.

name: Majestic Goat
description: A helmet shaped like the horns of a mountain goat. The moment it is worn, the user becomes the center of attention and feels a sense of pride. Holds strong religious symbolism.

name: Bone Helm
description: A very sturdy helmet made of bone. Though heavy and difficult to wear, its defensive capability is exceptional.

name: Orc Hero Headdress
description: The true helmet of Orc Hero. However, its size is so large that it might strain the wearer’s neck.
Has a chance to cast Weapon Perfection Lv 3 when performing attacks.

name: Cute Green Ribbon
description: Used to tie and hold hair in place, with a small ribbon on top to add extra cuteness.

name: Cute Red Ribbon
description: Used to tie and hold hair in place, with a small ribbon on top to add extra cuteness.

name: Cute Blue Ribbon
description: Used to tie and hold hair in place, with a small ribbon on top to add extra cuteness.

name: Cute White Ribbon
description: Used to tie and hold hair in place, with a small ribbon on top to add extra cuteness.

name: Hair Brush
description: Red axe-shaped hairpin worn on the head.

name: Frog Hat
description: A hat shaped after the frog god. Even if it is called a frog god, it does not look much different from a frog.
Physical and magical damage to Insect Monsters +12%.

name: Sting Hat
description: A soft, squishy hat modeled after the hand-shaped mud creature Sting. It seems the creator ignored the wearer’s comfort entirely.

name: Wild Rose Hat
description: A hat modeled after the fierce cat Wild Rose.

name: [Costume] Angel's Veil
description: A decorative veil made from numerous feathers.
Its voluminous wings give the feeling of being embraced by an angel.

name: [Costume] Fluttering Angel Wings
description: A costume wing that flutters gently.
It feels as though the blessing of the sky can be heard from its beautifully fluttering wings.

description: A coupon that lets you restore Clothes to their original color.

name: Fish With Blue Back

name: Makeover Brush

name: Paint Brush
description: Wide-bristled brush with a long handle, used exclusively for Ground Graffiti.

name: Wolf Flute
description: Very small whistle producing a sound audible only to wolves tamed by Rangers.

name: Eden Group Mark
description: Badge proving membership in the Eden Group. Designed for convenient carrying.

name: Carnium
description: One of the hardest metals on the continent of Midgard. It has exceptional strength, but its extreme hardness makes it difficult to refine. It can refine Lv. 1 armor with a refine level of +10 or higher.
(If refining fails, the equipment's refine level may decrease by 3 or the equipment may break.)

name: Bradium
description: One of the hardest metals found in Aeshvakhum. It was too hard to refine, but after continued research, weapon refinement has recently become possible. It can refine Lv. 1~4 weapons with a refine level of +10 or higher.
(If refining fails, the equipment's refine level may decrease by 3 or the equipment may break.)

name: Coral Reef
description: Seaweed that grows in the ocean.
Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Old Portrait
description: A self-portrait depicting a young girl. Worn with age, her features are hard to make out, but she seems quite adorable.

name: Bent Spoon
description: Heavily scratched spoon worn down into a straight line. Likely used by prisoners to dig escape tunnels.

name: Executioner's Glove
description: Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Mother's Nightmare
description: Mother who met an unfortunate end. Her memory remains vividly, giving an ominous feeling.

name: Foolishness of the Blind
description: Blind individual unable to distinguish objects. Easily deceived due to inability to see.

name: Old_Hilt
description: Old and worn sword hilt that still carries deep dignity. The blade is missing, leaving only the hilt.

name: Blade of Darkness
description: Black blade tainted by darkness, said to repel even light. Only the blade remains, yet it is so sharp that even the slightest touch can cut deeply.

name: Bloody Edge
description: A blade stained with blood that can't be cleansed.

name: Clock Tower Key
description: Key that can open a certain door within the Clock Tower.

name: Key of the Underground
description: Key that can open the underground door of the Clock Tower.

name: Old Frying Pan
description: An old, battered frying pan no longer suitable for cooking.
Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Piece of Egg Shell
description: Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Poison Spore
description: Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Matchstick
description: Stick coated with an easily flammable substance, capable of producing fire through friction.

name: Fine Grit
description: A crystal made entirely of fine sand.

name: Fine Sand
description: Sand so fine it is difficult to hold even with both hands.

name: Alice's Apron
description: An apron worn by the Alice monster.
Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Stone
description: Just a simple stone that you can pick up around anywhere.

name: Cyfar
description: Rare mineral with a faint blue glow.
Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Brigan
description: Rare mineral with a faint red glow.
Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Kafra Warp Free Ticket
description: Free pass that allows one complimentary use of Kafra Warp.

name: Kafra Cart Free Ticket
description: Free pass that allows one complimentary use of the Kafra Cart Service.

name: Soft Feather
description: Feather that evokes the same comforting temptation as a warm blanket wrapping you on a cold morning when you don’t want to get up.

name: Sea-otter Fur
description: Sea-Otter Leather that looks warm enough to make fine clothing. Its softness can be felt just from looking at it.

name: Ice Cubic
description: A miraculous lump of ice that will never melt.

name: Stone Fragment
description: A fragment of broken stone. It has a beautiful pattern and is said to be sold to stone collectors.

name: Tattered Clothes
description: Tattered and worn clothing scraps. No one knows who buys them, yet they sell surprisingly well.

name: Freya's Jewel
description: Brilliant gem said to have formed from the tears of Goddess Freyja. Merely gazing upon it is enchanting.

name: Thor's Gauntlets
description: Steel gloves said to have been worn by Thor when he hurled his hammer. Sturdy and practical in appearance, yet cannot be worn.

name: Iron Maiden
description: Brutal torture device said to have been used on women in a distant era. Their screams seem to echo from within even now.

name: Wheel of the Unknown
description: Gear-shaped object with no identifiable purpose. It must serve some function, but no one knows what that might be.

name: Silver Ornament
description: Ornate decorations made of silver. Can be fitted onto various things to create stylish effects.

name: Wrath of Valkyrie
description: Masterpiece sculpture crafted by an artisan who depicted the wrathful visage of Valkyries gathering warriors.

name: Feather of Angel Wing
description: Feather said to have fallen from an angel. Its authenticity cannot be confirmed.

name: Cat Tread
description: Curious item said to contain the sound of a cat’s footsteps, gathered and condensed into a tangible form.

name: Woman's Moustache
description: Collection of beards supposedly plucked from women. Surely they must have been rather masculine.

name: Root of Stone
description: Root-like formation said to have existed since the dawn of stone. Worth digging up stones along the roadside to find it.

name: Spirit of Fish
description: Bottle sealed with the soul said to dwell within fish. Its faint, transparent blue glow is beautiful.

name: Sputum of Bird
description: Long, narrow bottle said to contain saliva shed by birds.

name: Sinew of Bear
description: Bundle of powerful Bear Tendon. Shows remarkably elastic form.

name: Emblem of the Sun God
description: Bead symbolizing the sun god, glowing with dazzling golden light.

name: Breath of Spirit
description: Breath said to be exhaled by wandering souls. Touching it chills the living to the bone.

name: Snow Crystal
description: Large crystal formed from accumulated falling snow. Ice Crystal, always hexagonal, brings a sense of warmth to those who gaze upon it.

name: Omen of Tempest
description: Bottle containing an image foretelling an approaching, powerful storm.

name: Ripple
description: Bottle capturing the image of gentle waves brushing against the feet on a clear day at the seaside.

name: Billow
description: Sculpture depicting the rough waves crashing against the coast on a windy day.

name: Drifting Air
description: Crafted by an artisan inspired by air that moves unseen yet never ceases.

name: Live Coal
description: Ember not fully extinguished, faintly glowing red as it clings to the last of its oxygen.

name: Worn-out Magic Scroll
description: Weathered magic circle whose purpose can no longer be discerned. The Magic Academy buys them at high prices.

name: Sharp Leaf
description: Leaf shimmering with razor-sharp blue light. Getting cut by it hurts terribly.

name: Broken Sword
description: Broken sword cracked beyond further use. Nearly a piece of scrap Cheol-i.

name: Broken Pharaoh Emblem
description: Once symbol of Pharaoh, now shattered and barely able to exert any of its former power…

name: Masque of Tutankhamen
description: Golden mask said to have been worn by a certain Pharaoh. Its shape and color are splendid, yet the fact that it is a death mask is unsettling.

name: Torn Magic Book
description: Torn magic tome once called the lifeline of a wizard. Its owner is unknown, and the contents are far too damaged to read.

name: Bacillus
description: Tissue forming the body of mushrooms or molds.

name: Honey Pot
description: Once a Honey Jar filled with honey, now completely emptied—someone must have eaten it all.

name: Dragon Skin
description: Piece cut from beneath Dragon Scale after removing the scale itself.

name: Scorpion Claw
description: Exceptionally sharp Scorpion Claw, gleaming with a slick sheen.

name: Large Jellopy
description: Enormous mass of Jellopy, though no one knows how or where it was formed.

name: Alcohol Creation Guide
description: Book describing methods for producing alcohol.

name: Bottle Grenade Creation Guide
description: Book detailing how to create Bottle Grenade. Not recommended for use in demonstrations.

name: Acid Bottle Creation Guide
description: Book explaining how to manufacture Acid Bottle. Hydrochloric acid is highly corrosive, so handle with care.

name: Plant Bottle Creation Guide
description: Book describing how to create a bottle containing carnivorous plants. These are not simple insectivores—handle with caution.

name: Marine Sphere Creation Guide
description: Book outlining the process of crafting naval mines. A mine is a bomb that floats in air or water and detonates on contact. Use extreme caution when making them.

name: Glistening Coat Creation Guide
description: Book recording how to produce Coating Agent. Applying the coating leaves a glossy, polished finish.

name: Slim Potion Creation Guide
description: Book describing how to brew slim potions. Contains knowledge to create potions enjoyed by many users.

name: Medicine Bowl
description: Mortar Bowl used to finely grind herbs. Made of porcelain and polished to a white shine.

name: Bottle Grenade
description: Lighting the fuse and throwing it will engulf the surroundings in flames.

name: Acid Bottle
description: Target struck by this bottle will suffer severe wounds. Never throw it at people.

name: Plant Bottle
description: Thrown onto the ground, it instantly sprouts into a man-eating plant that attacks any nearby creature.

name: Marine Sphere Bottle
description: Upon being thrown, the mine mechanism inside activates and lies in wait for its victim.

name: Glistening Coat
description: Bottle containing a shimmering substance with a dazzling glow that captivates the eyes.

name: Seed of Life
description: Extraordinary seed radiating abundant vitality even at a glance.

name: Yggdrasil Morning Dew
description: Dawn dew gathered upon Yggdrasil Berry.

name: Embryo
description: Embryonic form of some unknown being.

name: Glass Tube
description: Capable of sustaining life even for someone near death, and able to nurture embryos placed inside.

name: Potion Creation Guide
description: Manual describing the method for producing standard potions.

name: Solid Peach
description: Peach so hard that it could deflect blades. Cannot be eaten, but would hurt considerably if thrown.

name: Tuxedo
description: Men’s wedding suit with a clean, elegant design. Some tease its wearer by calling him a penguin.

name: Cacao
description: Tree commonly known as cocoa, native to warm regions and classified as a dicot of the Malvaceae family. Its fruit, once harvested and dried, becomes cacao beans. Roasting and grinding them yields cacao paste, which can be compressed to extract fat and produce cocoa, while the extracted fat is known as cacao butter. Adding milk flavor during the cacao paste stage and allowing it to set results in chocolate.

name: Thin Trunk
description: Slender vine used by plants to cling to objects as they grow upward.

name: Brown Root
description: Brown plant root still covered in soil.

name: Wooden Heart
description: Magical wooden core powering Wooden Golems.

name: Sprout
description: Fresh sprout newly emerged from a plant seed.

name: Soft Blade of Grass
description: Pale-green Soft Leaf with a very soft texture to the touch.

name: Slingshot
description: Tool enabling ranged attacks, made by connecting Elastic Rope between appropriately spaced Sturdy Branches and using stones as projectiles.

name: Shoulder Protector
description: Primitive shoulder guard carved from wood for basic protection.

name: Tough Vines
description: Extremely tough vine that cannot be torn by hand. Could function well as a rope.

name: Huge Leaf
description: Large Leaf that looks as though it could be worn on the head during rain.

name: Elastic Band
description: Stretchy cord that snaps back to its original length with applied force. Surprisingly fun to play with.

name: Log
description: Piece of wood that looks suitable for crafting into various items.

name: Pincher of Beetle
description: Developed front claw of a crustacean. Getting pinched would certainly hurt.

name: Strong Branch
description: Sturdy-looking tree branch seemingly useful for many purposes.

name: Fragment of Rossata Stone
description: A stone engraved with ancient hieroglyphs.

name: Gold Bullion
description: Block of pure gold refined from countless ore pieces. Highly malleable and ductile, making it a widely used form of currency.

name: Silver Bullion
description: Block of pure silver refined from numerous ore pieces. Valued for its malleability and pale sheen, often used as currency.

name: Platinum Bullion
description: Block of platinum polished into a clean square. Rarer than gold and possessing several times its value.

name: Pinafore
description: Soft cloth placed under a baby's chin to keep milk or drool from staining clothing.

name: Nursing Bottle
description: Milk prepared in a baby-friendly bottle.

name: Red Chili
description: Commonly used as a spice, this fiery red ingredient brings a hellish heat the moment it touches the tongue.

name: Agate
description: Mineral found in spherical or oval shapes, with names varying by color and pattern. Beautiful ones are used as gemstones.

name: Muscovite
description: Mineral with perfect scale-like crystals, often called White Stone Scales. Its glossy surface symbolizes renewed motivation.

name: Rose Quartz
description: Pale pink quartz that turns blue when left in open air for long periods. Represents personal elevation.

name: Turquoise
description: Well-known decorative stone with a glossy pale-blue or sky-blue hue. Signifies mental command.

name: Citrin
description: Clear quartz once believed to be ancient frozen ice. Yellow-tinted varieties represent good communication and composure.

name: Pyroxene
description: Rock-forming mineral found in the earth’s crust and meteorites. Transparent pink or green types are prized as gemstones.

name: Biotite
description: Most common form of mica, resembling dark scales.

name: Leaf Clothes
description: Two large leaves barely covering the front and back. Using them to wrap food might feel a bit unsettling.

name: Gemstone
description: Unrefined gemstone containing various minerals. Might yield multiple types of jewels once processed.

name: Free Ticket for Peco Ride
description: Allows one free use of Peco Peco.

name: Old Pickaxe
description: A tool commonly used to dig hard, solid ground. It seems to bear the traces of a laborer's sweat.

name: Several Books
description: Collection of Bundle of Books. Quite heavy.

name: Leather Pouch
description: Sturdy-looking Leather Pouch containing a few items.

name: Empty Scroll
description: Blank scroll developed at the Juno Magic Academy for storing unwritten magic formulas.

name: Elemental Potion Creation Guide
description: Cover reads: 'Even a Poring becomes an Elemental Potion Master with this!'
A book that clearly explains how to craft elemental potions.

name: Treasure Box
description: Old Treasure Chest filled with ancient coins, ornaments, and jewels.
Can be sold to the Collector.

name: Yellow Spice
description: Yellow powder with a unique aroma that enhances the flavor of food.

name: Sweet Sauce
description: Sweet, intensely flavored liquid that enhances the taste of dishes. Drinking it straight feels like it could melt your tongue.

name: Plain Sauce
description: Savory sauce that adds a clean, mild flavor to cooking.

name: Hot Sauce
description: A fiercely spicy sauce whose aroma alone can bring tears. Said to create the flavor of a 'fiery man.'

name: Red Spice
description: Red powder with a sharp, zesty aroma that enriches the flavor of food.

name: Cooking Oil
description: Edible oil that adds a glossy finish and a nutty fragrance to dishes. Some even drink it as is.

name: Lv.1 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'Never panic when you're alone. With this, you can survive anywhere.'

name: Lv.2 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'A mother's touch that heals even the heart. For those who long for the warmth of family.'

name: Lv.3 Cookbook
description: A Rune-Midgard bestseller for novice housewives! Don't miss this chance!
Cover message leaves a strong impression.

name: Lv.4 Cookbook
description: A touching cooking story no one can resist.

name: Lv.5 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'Reborn as a true chef. Challenge yourself toward the Spoon of God!'

name: Lv.6 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'One who cooks even in a sealed room — the result is always the same! Every dish ends up in this pot!!'

name: Lv.7 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'If you're hungry, whether you're a Poring or a Poporing, you'll be served!'

name: Lv.8 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'A lone chef now wanders across Rune-Midgard...!! — An epic tale of culinary inspiration —'

name: Lv.9 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'A chef who attempted a forbidden legendary dish, losing both his own and his sibling's sense of taste in the process.'

name: Lv.10 Cookbook
description: Cover reads: 'First woman in the history of Prontera Kingdom to rise as the Royal Master Chef!! — Includes the author's autograph.'

name: Pot
description: Cooking utensil used to prepare food. Different tools are used depending on the dish.

name: Old Heart Piece
description: Fragment of a heart removed during preparation of a Mummy to preserve the body for a long time.

name: Enriched Elunium
description: A dense Elunium metal that has been condensed deep underground over a long period of time.
Increases the success rate of armor refinement.

name: Enriched Oridecon
description: A dense Oridecon metal that has been condensed deep underground over a long period of time.
Increases the success rate of weapon refinement.

name: Token of Siegfried
description: Emblem imbued with the energy of Acoustic Rhythm.
Said to allow the bearer to overcome death.
Upon death, consumes the item to revive immediately at the place of death.

name: New Style Coupon
description: Perfect for those seeking a unique hairstyle!
An item for anyone who wants something distinct from everyone else.

name: War Badge
description: Mark signifying participation in battle. Taken from the clothing of someone defeated in combat.

name: Poring Egg
description: Egg containing the sleeping pet Poring. The dormant creature can be awakened using a [Portable Egg Incubator].
[color=0000FF]If not cared for properly, it may disappear.[/color]
Able to grant the power of pet Poring.

description: Egg containing the sleeping pet Drops. The dormant creature can be awakened using a [Portable Egg Incubator].
[color=0000FF]If not cared for properly, it may disappear.[/color]

description: Egg containing the sleeping Ground Petite. The dormant creature can be awakened using a [Portable Egg Incubator].
[color=0000FF]If not cared for properly, it may disappear.[/color]

At 1 Lv: ASPD increases (After Attack Delay -1%).
At 2 Lv: ASPD increases (After Attack Delay -1%), AGI +1.

description: Egg containing the sleeping pet Deviruchi. The dormant creature can be awakened using a [Portable Egg Incubator].

At 2 Lv: Physical Damage to All Grades of Enemies +1%, MATK +1%, MHP/MSP +1%.

description: Special pet egg that allows Fei-chai to be awakened with a Portable Egg Incubator.
Able to grant the power of pet Fei-chai.
At 1 Lv: AGI +1, ASPD increases (After Attack Delay -1%).
At 2 Lv: AGI +3, ASPD increases (After Attack Delay -3%).

name: Tai-zi Egg
description: Special pet egg that allows Tai-zi to be awakened with a Portable Egg Incubator.
Able to grant the power of pet Tai-zi.

name: [Event] Blessing of Yggdrasil
description: Blessing of Yggdrasil that increases EXP and Item Drop Rate for 30 days.
The character who uses this item gains the 30-day buff effect:
Includes 1 Yggdrasil Staff, which summons the World Tree Guardian who provides additional services.
[color=FF0000]Warning! - Yggdrasil Staff cannot be used in Memorial Dungeons (MD).[/color]

name: [Event] Blue Potion 10ea Box
description: Convenient for taking out as needed.

name: Skull Helm
description: Helm carved from an animal skull. Crude design, but overflowing with a primitive atmosphere.

name: Monster Oxygen Mask
description: Mask made so that even small pets can use it. Helps keep pets healthy.

name: Transparent Head Protector
description: Round headguard made from magical material. Unlike other materials, it is shaped so breathing is still possible.

name: Pacifier
description: Pacifier toy played with by small children. Made from gentle material that is harmless to them.

name: Fashion Wig
description: Showy wig appealing to those who want a unique look. Its three bright colors easily draw everyone’s attention.

name: Queen's Hair Ornament
description: Headdress said to have been worn by an ancient queen. Design radiates such overwhelming dignity that it makes you bow your head, yet also stirs a strange urge to defy that majesty.

name: Silk Ribbon
description: High-quality ribbon made from soft Claw. Compared to Guitar and other ribbons, it feels especially soft to wear.

name: Punisher
description: Rod used for discipline in the name of education. Of course, it can also serve as a sufficiently intimidating weapon.

name: Wild Flower
description: Flower that bloomed alone in the wild without anyone’s help.

name: Battered Pot
description: A dented cooking pot worn down from years of use. Still usable for meals, and strangely charming in its own way.

name: Tiny Egg Shell
description: Eggshell made small so that pets can wear it.

name: Poring Pet Backpack
description: Bag for carrying various things. Mainly designed for books, so it is called School Backpack.

name: Rocker Glasses
description: Strange pair of glasses that somehow make the wearer look less kind and rather sly.

name: Green Lace
description: Green lace made to be worn by a pet or a baby.

name: Golden Bell
description: Bell made of gold. Produces an exquisitely clear sound.

name: Bark Shorts
description: Light wooden pants roughly put together. In hot regions they are light and help prevent sweating.

name: Monkey Circlet
description: Circlet that seems to suit Yoyo perfectly.

name: Grave Keeper's Sword
description: Ceremonial sword said to have been used by a spirit priest who guided the dead. Unsuitable to use as an actual weapon.

name: Novice Combination Book
description: Too easy! Even Yoyo… no, even Fabre could do it!
Just follow this book like a 1-minute cooking guide and you will get the result exactly as written.
[color=FF0000]Caution: To begin a combination, you must [Double Click] the item “Combination Kit”.[/color]
[color=FF0000]Caution: You must carry all required combination materials for the item you wish to create.[/color]

name: Novice Blue Potion
description: Blue Herb finely ground into a special mental recovery tonic for Newbie. [color=000088]Recovers about 5 SP[/color].

name: WoE Violet Potion
description: Usable only in WoE areas, PvP areas, and towns.
A potion with a taste somewhere between Red Potion and Blue Potion. Somehow, it reminds you of the Savage roaming the Mjolnir Mountains.

name: WoE White Potion
description: Usable only in WoE areas, PvP areas, and towns.
White Potion made only from the youngest leaves of organic white herbs, giving it a refreshing taste.

name: WoE Blue Potion
description: Usable only in WoE areas, PvP areas, and towns.
Blue Potion made only from the youngest leaves of organic blue herbs, giving it a refreshing taste.

name: Savory Herb Salad
description: Fragrant herb dish mixed with a refreshing sauce. Surprisingly energizing when eaten.

name: Apple Carrot Salad
description: Crisp harmony of apples and carrots! A crunchy salad that lifts your mood.

name: Casual Stew
description: A stew made by tossing in whatever the cook felt like adding.

name: Golden Roasted Apple
description: Whole roasted apple dripping with golden juice that makes your mouth water.

name: [NFS] White Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from White Herb. [color=000088]Recovers about 325 HP[/color].

name: [NFS] Yellow Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Yellow Herb. [color=000088]Recovers about 175 HP[/color].

name: Novice Red Potion
description: Special recovery tonic crafted just for Newbie beginning their adventure! [color=000088]Recovers a small amount of HP[/color].

name: [NFS] Orange Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Red Herb and Yellow Herb. [color=000088]Recovers about 105 HP[/color].

name: [NFS] Red Potion
description: Recovery tonic finely ground from Red Herb. [color=000088]Recovers about 45 HP[/color].

name: [NFS] Green Potion
description: Healing tonic finely ground from Green Herb. Cures [color=000088]Poison[/color], [color=000088]Silence[/color], [color=000088]Blind[/color], and [color=000088]Confusion[/color].

name: [NFS] Blue Potion
description: Mental recovery tonic finely ground from Blue Herb. [color=000088]Recovers about 60 SP[/color].

name: Fresh Milk
description: Freshly Squeezed Milk. Commonly used as a nutritious drink for growing children. [color=000088]Recovers a small amount of HP[/color].

name: Raw Sweet Potato

name: Pork

description: Ribs always taste better grilled over charcoal~♬

name: Box of Panting
description: 30% chance to inflict Silence for 30 seconds. Recovers 9% SP.

name: Stone of Sage
description: A legendary stone said to possess mystical alchemical power capable of turning base metals into gold. Warm and smooth with a red glow.

name: Fried Grasshopper
description: A simple dish even a Newbie can prepare. Tastes like fresh grass from an open field.

name: Flipper Salad
description: A rare dish that may look unappealing at first, but opens the door to a whole new world once tasted.

name: Bomber Steak
description: Looks like an ordinary steak, yet delivers an explosive burst of flavor the moment it's eaten.

name: Herb Marinade Beef
description: Marinated ribs enhanced with herbs, using a cooking technique passed down in Payon for added aroma.

name: Lutie Lady's Pancake
description: A sweet pancake crafted with the delicate touch of the Lady from Lutie. A taste that lifts the spirit.

name: Grape Juice Herbal Tea
description: A refreshing tea infused with grape essence and herbal aroma. Clears the mind—though it may simply taste like grape juice.

name: Autumn Red Tea
description: A tea blending three types of herbs to create a rich and harmonious fragrance. The taste itself is merely adequate.

name: Honey Herbal Tea
description: Herbal tea sweetened with honey for extra comfort. Handle with care—it’s served hot.

name: Morrcc Fruit Wine
description: A fruit wine crafted by a Merchant from Morroc using tangy fruits. Light and enjoyable even for those unaccustomed to alcohol.

name: Mastela Fruit Wine
description: A distilled drink made from Mastela fruit refined solely for mental clarity. Best enjoyed in moderation.

name: Steamed Crab
description: A simple dish of herbs boiled together with Claw Meat. Properly separating the shell is the key to enjoying it.

name: Assorted Seafood
description: A dish that evokes deep nostalgia for those born by the sea. Some say it brings tears to their eyes without warning.

name: Clam Soup
description: Shellfish boiled to preserve the full ocean flavor. Both the broth and the Shell Meat are meant to be enjoyed.

name: Seasoned Jellyfish
description: "Tentacle lightly cooked with squid ink and herbs. Looks delicious, yet the taste is unexpectedly subtle.

name: Spicy Fried Bao
description: Spicy grilled dumplings with a stimulating aroma. Eating too many may lead to regret the next day.

name: Frog Egg Squid Ink Soup
description: A soup made by gently boiling frog eggs. Best consumed in one swift bite with your eyes closed.

name: Smooth Noodle
description: Noodles with silky strands crafted by a master, so smooth they are almost difficult to eat.

name: Tentacle Cheese Gratin
description: Gratin made by stuffing slippery Tentacle with sweet Sweet Potato and rich cheese, baked until golden. Its flavor seems slightly different from the well-known children’s snack.

name: Lutie Cold Noodle
description: Dish where chill and spiciness blend in a delicate balance, with pumpkin used as a distinctive garnish.

name: Steamed Bat Wing in Pumpkin
description: Nourishing dish made by wrapping the mysterious ingredient Red Bat Wing in Hinalle leaves, then simmering it inside a hollowed pumpkin. Has a rather peculiar taste.

name: Honey Grape Juice
description: Special Grape Juice made by blending Grape Juice with nutritious honey. Sweet and pleasantly tangy.

name: Chocolate Mousse Cake
description: Signature chocolate mousse cake highly praised by royal dessert chef “Charles d'Orléans”, with a smooth texture and sweet, bittersweet flavor.

name: Fruit Mix
description: Dessert made by cutting assorted fruits into bite-sized pieces and soaking them in syrup. Crisp texture is its greatest charm.

name: Cream Sandwich
description: Light sandwich made with freshly baked bread filled with minced meat and cream cheese. Feels perfect as a lunch option.

name: Green Salad
description: Salad of healthy vegetables tossed in a sweet Umbala-style dressing. Latest wellness menu trend in Prontera.

name: Fried Monkey Tails
description: Monkey tail lightly stir-fried and simply seasoned. Rumored to be an extremely popular snack to go with drinks.

name: Mixed Juice
description: Mixed Juice made by skillfully blending various fruit juices. Getting the ratio wrong may send you into a whole new world.

name: Fried Sweet Potato
description: Dish made by deep-frying Sweet Potato and then simmering it with syrup. Crispy and sweet, making it a very popular snack.

name: Steamed Ancient Lips
description: Fish dish made by steaming freshly caught fish together with Ancient Fish Lips, believed to be good for health, wrapped in fragrant leaves. Said to be more popular among men than women.

name: Fried Scorpion Tails
description: Dish made by stir-frying only the tastiest part, the Scorpion Tail. The hard shell is cracked to enjoy the tender flesh inside. Slightly poisonous, so eating too much is not good for the body.

name: Shiny Marinade Beef
description: Grilled beef dish so exquisite that those who have tried it bestowed upon it the title of “Shining”.

name: Whole Roast
description: Large cut of meat grilled whole with spicy sauce. Said to be the ultimate dish for true meat lovers.

name: Bearfoot Special
description: Dish counted among the greatest delicacies of Yongji Castle, said to be especially prized when made using the right sole.

name: Tendon Satay
description: Top-quality tendons quickly grilled so the natural flavor of the ingredients remains intact.

name: Steamed Tongue
description: Finest-grade dish that is soft and delicious, with the only drawback being its expensive ingredients. Said to have also come from Yongji Castle.

name: Red Mushroom Wine
description: Wine made from aged grapes, yet said to taste completely different from regular wine. The secret is rumored to lie in the use of mushrooms.

name: Special Royal Jelly Herbal Tea
description: Herbal tea sweetened with Royal Jelly and honey, known to aid mental recovery, though its aroma is often considered unpleasant.

name: Royal Family Tea
description: A signature royal dessert by Charles d’Orléans, whose sweet aroma is said to drift beyond the castle walls during tea time.

name: Tristan 12-Year
description: Premium liquor crafted to commemorate the coronation of Tristan III, with the 12-year vintage considered the finest.

name: Dragon Breath Cocktail
description: Liquor with a fierce flavor said to let you feel a dragon’s breath from a single sip. Those who taste it claim they can never forget it.

name: Awfully Bitter Bracer
description: Some say medicine becomes more effective as its unpleasant taste grows stronger, though such claims remain unverified.

name: Sumptuous Feast
description: A curious dish said to bring tears as vivid mountains and blue seas unfold in your mind after eating it.

name: Giant Burito
description: A massive wrap seemingly made oversized on purpose so it cannot be eaten in a single bite. The creator’s intention is unmistakable.

name: Ascending Dragon Soup
description: Spicy dish made with ‘dragon’ as its main ingredient; those who try it say it feels as though they start to ascend.

name: Immortal Stew
description: Though its appearance and smell are rather unsettling, eating it is said to instill a strange sense of immortality.

name: Chile Shrimp Gratin
description: Gratin combining chili heat with savory shrimp—yet it tastes more like a spicy shrimp dish than a gratin.

name: Steamed Alligator with Vegetable
description: A recommended Umbala dish of lightly roasted crocodile meat wrapped with vegetables and steamed. Rumor says it is reserved for honored guests and cherished livestock.

name: Incredibly Spicy Curry
description: A fiercely spicy curry said to contain the ‘taste of endurance’. The key element is a pumpkin that strangely feels like it was once worn as a hat.

name: Special Meat Stew
description: A specialty of the Dragon Castle region—slow-simmered assorted meats whose aroma spreads widely when the lid is opened.

name: Steamed Desert Scorpions
description: A steamed desert scorpion dish considered one of the four great delicacies of the Sograt Desert, cooked using the heat of the sands.

name: Peach Cake
description: Refreshing cake made with Kunlun’s specialty peaches, known for their incredibly soft texture and fragrant taste.

name: Soul Haunted Bread
description: Sweet bread so intense that some say it feels as though one’s soul might fly away; others claim their tongue nearly melts.

name: Special Toast
description: Massive toast filled with meat, fruit, and cheese—about three times the usual amount. Despite the abundance, the taste remains uncertain.

name: Heavenly Fruit Juice
description: A juice described by every taster as giving the sensation of ‘soaring into the sky’. Proper fruit balance is said to be crucial.

name: Hwergelmir's Tonic
description: Liquor so revered that it was named after a legendary spring—the very source of all rivers. Everyone who tried it praised it endlessly.

name: Lucky Soup
description: Dish said to bring extraordinary fortune only when eaten while fiercely hot. Then again… it may just be a rumor.

name: Assorted Shish Kebob
description: Skewered dish made by grilling long, thin cuts of assorted meats. Popular for letting diners choose ingredients to suit their taste.

name: Strawberry Flavored Rice Ball
description: Rice ball with the refreshing flavor and aroma of strawberries. A rare experience that feels like eating strawberries as a side dish.

name: Blood Flavored Soda
description: Carbonated soda loved by children for its sharp, fizzy taste. Slight hint of metallic flavor… but still enjoyable enough to overlook.

name: Cooked Nine Tail's Tails
description: Payon specialty cuisine made from the tail of Nine Tail, widely regarded across Rune-Midgarts as a dish of good fortune.

name: Tropical Sograt
description: Sweet yet strong alcoholic drink made by aging assorted fruits, famous in Morroc. Said to reach its best flavor when matured in the desert climate.

name: Charcoal-Broiled Breath Dumpling
description: Dumplings seared over intense flames reminiscent of a dragon’s breath. The powerful heat drives out excess moisture and oil, leaving them crisp and clean—a signature dish of Komodo.

name: Dragon Head Cookie
description: Snack shaped after the head of the legendary sea dragon from Komodo folklore. The icing on the whiskers is especially delicious. Deliver it to the children playing on the Komodo [color=FFFFFF]<NAVI>[/color][color=4D4DFF][Beach][/color]<INFO>comodo,194,145,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.

name: Dragon Beard Candy
description: Delicate strands of honey pulled and stretched like fine thread. Legend claims they are made from the whiskers of Komodo’s sea dragon. Said to bring special luck at the Komodo [color=FFFFFF]<NAVI>[/color][color=4D4DFF][Casino][/color]<INFO>comodo,157,97,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.

name: Zelstar
description: Gem formed from Jellopy buried underground for thousands of years under extreme heat and pressure. Can be exchanged for the fashion currency [color=4D4DFF][Fashion Stone][/color] or used to draw useful consumables from [color=4D4DFF][Special Toolbox][/color].
Also serves various purposes such as world-travel services and refining (ore synthesis).

name: Yggdrasil Dew
description: Returning it to the Yggdrasil tree grants its blessing.

name: Faintly Glowing Crystal
description: Mineral-shaped mass formed when magical energy condenses within a living body, faintly radiating power.
Rumor has it that a certain craftsman is looking for this gem to create a rare item. Let's collect them for now.

name: Mithril Ore
description: Raw stone containing the precious mineral Mithril.

name: Mithril
description: Pure Mithril crystal refined from Mithril Ore.
Light yet exceptionally sturdy, Mithril is used for countless purposes.

name: Cursed Emerald
description: Emerald infused with a black Curse.
Extremely rare, and the strong malice surrounding the gem may be harnessed in some way.

name: Shimmering Opal
description: Opal that emits a shimmering glow.
Extremely rare, with a radiant inner power slumbering within the gem.

name: Sapphire of the Blue Sea
description: Sapphire imbued with the power of the blue sea.
Extremely rare, and the sea’s energy appears to dwell within the gem.

name: Ruby Soaked in Blood
description: Ruby infused with a blood-red Curse.
Extremely rare, and careless use may cause the curse to engulf its wielder.

name: [Event] HD Oridecon
description: A delicate ore that ensures the safety of precious equipment.
- When refining a weapon with a Refine Level of +7 or higher, the weapon will not be destroyed even if refinement fails! However, equipment at +10 or higher cannot be refined. -
(Refine Level decreases by 1 if refinement fails.)

name: [Event] HD Elunium
description: A delicate ore that ensures the safety of precious equipment.
- When refining armor with a Refine Level of +7 or higher, the armor will not be destroyed even if refinement fails! However, equipment at +10 or higher cannot be refined. -
(Refine Level decreases by 1 if refinement fails.)

name: [Event] HD Carnium
description: It has been compressed for an unimaginably long time, increasing its density and strength. It seems to be more demanding for refining armor.
- When refining armor with a Refine Level of +10 or higher, the armor will not be destroyed even if refinement fails! -
(Refine Level decreases by 1 if refinement fails.)

name: [Event] HD Bradium
description: Through repeated research by Midgard scholars, its density and strength have been further increased. It seems to have become more difficult to refine Weapons.
- When refining a Weapon with a refine level of +10 or higher, the Weapon will not be destroyed even if refinement fails! -
(If refinement fails, the refine level decreases by 1.)

name: Ribello's Toy
description: A toy Ribello used to play with. When I shook Ribello, it fell off. Let's be sure to return it someday.

name: Scribbled Diary Fragment
description: A diary fragment that fell out after shaking Readword. Upon closer inspection, it says..."Today, the thing my older brother treasures..." It seems Readword damaged something precious to Rideword.

name: Large Siege Purple Potion
description: Usable only in WoE areas, PvP areas, and towns.
A potion with a taste somewhere between Red Potion and Blue Potion. Somehow, it reminds you of the Savage roaming the Mjolnir Mountains.
It boasts a capacity that’s 50% larger than the original.

name: Baby Shark Bread
description: Delicious Bread modeled after Baby Shark.
[color=FF0000](This item will be deleted when the event ends.)[/color]

name: Baby Shark Singing Candy
description: A cute lollipop modeled after Baby Shark's face.
It somehow makes you want to sing!
[color=FF0000](This item will be deleted when the event ends.)[/color]

name: [GetPoring] Pecoring Device
description: Activate this Pecoring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A copycat Poring that imitates Peco Peco.
It practices every day, but it still cannot shake its habit of bouncing around.

name: [GetPoring] Baphoring Jr. Device
description: Activate this Baphoring Jr.-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Poring that dreamed of becoming a terrifying boss monster, but somehow ended up only half-complete.
It has no dignity at all, so others tend to look down on it.

name: [GetPoring] Snowring Device
description: Activate this Snowring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Poring that evolved into a snow globe.
After going through earthquakes and snowstorms every day, it barely blinks at most natural disasters.

name: [GetPoring] Kapparing Device
description: Activate this Kapparing-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Poring that looks older than it is because of its bald head.
In truth, it is still a baby whose beak has not even grown in yet.

name: [GetPoring] Poodle Poring Device
description: Activate this Poodle Poring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Poring that decided to become an outer coat to protect a poodle that had lost all of its fur.
It guarantees 100% safety no matter what accident happens.

name: [GetPoring] Takoring Device
description: Activate this Takoring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Poring that was evolving into an octopus, but somehow became a baby octopus instead.
In a hurry, it put on a takoyaki outfit.

name: [GetPoring] Parfait Nyang Device
description: Activate this Parfait Nyang-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A parfait Poring that wants to become a cute cat.
It piles on toppings to dress up like a cat, but it is so sweet that it always ends up melting.

name: [GetPoring] Onigiring Device
description: Activate this Onigiring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
The leader of the delinquent Onigiring Gang.
It takes great pride in its bouncy regent hairstyle.

name: [GetPoring] Nutsring Device
description: Activate this Nutsring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
The mother peanut and supreme authority of the peanut family.
To shut down her family's demands in one swift move, she mastered the deadly poker face skill.

name: [GetPoring] Withering Device
description: Activate this Withering-shaped device to have it accompany you.
Once a symbol of vitality, this herb lost its strength from too many baths.
Now it does not even have the energy to stand, so it crawls around on its trembling limbs.

name: [GetPoring] Baby Deviruchi Device
description: Activate this Baby Deviruchi-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Deviruchi who was jealous of Baby Poring, beloved by everyone.
It thought looking the same would make everyone love it too, but it could not resist playing pranks, so today's plan seems to have failed yet again.

name: [GetPoring] Trapring Device
description: Activate this Trapring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Poring that somehow got caught by a Venus flytrap.
The inside of its mouth is surprisingly comfortable.
Food even flies in on its own while it just sits there.
Does it really need to leave...?

name: [GetPoring] Kiwiring Device
description: Activate this Kiwiring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Kiwiring who believes there must be a special reason it was born as only one half.
Convinced that its perfect other half is somewhere out there, it quietly sidles up beside anything round it sees.

name: [GetPoring] Zomboring Device
description: Activate this Zomboring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Poring that awakened again at death's door.
To avoid being mistaken for something scary, it wears a heart on its head.
It calls it a cute accessory, but judging by how desperately it searches whenever it falls off, it must be rather important.

name: [GetPoring] UFOring Device
description: Activate this UFOring-shaped device to have it accompany you.
A Poring that evolved into a special form after absorbing a mysterious energy.
Sometimes it makes a meaningful-looking expression and speaks in an alien language.
When asked what it means, it brushes the question aside, saying it cannot be expressed in any language on Earth.

name: Guild Parma
description: A small Shield that can be equipped on the arm, providing additional defense. It can be used alone, but provides little defense.
[color=FF0000](This item will be deleted when the event ends.)[/color]
